# Kenshien Alao

> Backend developer focused on engineering reliable APIs, database architectures, and scalable server-side systems.

## About

Kenshien Alao is a backend developer based in Marikina, Philippines. His work centers on designing and engineering robust server-side applications with a focus on API design, database modeling, query optimization, security, and maintainable architecture.

His core interests and technical expertise include REST APIs, authentication, data validation, database systems (PostgreSQL), server performance, caching, and scalable backend design.
